test_basis: Reviewed application image and a network-isolated temporary PostgreSQL restore of the existing November 18 recovery set. Test-owned drafts, pins, assumptions and decisions were confined to this copy. Issuer figures are public and prices and personal research are omitted.

checks.api_scope: The four companies each returned HTTP 200 through the normal authenticated backend routes for first-model preview, price timeline and pinned decision choices. Every preview contained two eligible filing revisions and withheld the model value. Each timeline returned 250 observations.
checks.cutoff: End of November 12, 2026 in New York. All eight filing revisions had date precision.
checks.recovery: Restored the existing complete backup to temporary memory-backed PostgreSQL, migrated the copy to x6x6x6x6x6x6 and validated the original recovery set's manifest and checksums. The installed database still reported w5w5w5w5w5w5.

filing_to_valuation.source_basis: US GAAP consolidated annual financial statements. Each displayed revenue and net income was checked against the issuer's original 10-K and the selected SEC companyfacts revision. Each net income used the NetIncomeLoss concept. Amounts below are in USD millions. The model received full USD.
filing_to_valuation.workflow: For each company, a fresh disposable draft selected both revisions as available by the research date and ran the first-model preview. All eight were eligible. All four previews correctly withheld a calculated value. Model counts stayed constant.
filing_to_valuation.field_scope: Field lists describe fresh FCFF drafts without personal forecast choices. They include separate currency, financing and review requirements and do not change which of the twenty tracked historical company/input combinations have source support.

benchmarks.verification: All twelve active originals matched their stored SHA-256 and byte length. The active records matched between the live installation and the recovery copy. For the six US workbooks the Advertising row in Industry Averages had 52 firms and the listed measure agreed with the publisher's rendered US table at its displayed precision. For India the 24-firm Advertising row was present in all six local originals. The publisher's index identified all twelve download locations.

dated_publisher_evidence.coverage: The author's dated article links directly to the US and India beta and cost-of-capital workbook locations. The URLs can be updated in place.

benchmarks.historical_eligibility: The observed January data date, October import receipts, table matches and dated links do not establish a publisher release date for each exact workbook version. All twelve publication fields remain unassigned. The four companies had zero saved industry mixes in both the live and recovery inventories. Assigning segment revenues to a benchmark industry still requires support for that mapping.

price_and_thesis.scope: Stored personal-use US dollar unadjusted closes from November 10, 2025 through November 6, 2026, queried through November 12. Only coverage counts and public filing locations are reported.
price_and_thesis.workflow: Saved a private test pin for one actual marked close per ticker. Each identical retry returned the original pin. Recorded a needs-more-evidence decision against a test assumption, then retried it. Each retained its price snapshot and created a single receipt for that submission. Apple's additional preceding-close selection preserved its filing and earlier-date label. Meta and Alphabet retained the same-date, order-unknown label on their stored 10-Qs. The test changed zero valuation versions and contributes zero days of user use.
price_and_thesis.interpretation: A dated release or filing supplies research context. These checks did not establish why a security moved. The two additional issuer releases were checked externally and were not written to the live database.

nvidia_notes.later_disclosure: NVIDIA reported a USD 1 billion repayment of senior notes in its third quarter. The commentary does not identify a payment date or tranche.
nvidia_notes.november_12_treatment: Retain the scheduled maturity as known. Exclude the later repayment disclosure. A complete financing bridge is still missing.

alphabet_da.scope: The retained SEC companyfacts snapshot contains interim observations for the intangible expense and no eligible full-year observation for FY2023, FY2024 or FY2025. The 2025 quarterly amounts sum to the nine-month disclosure. Annual combined D&A remains partial.

financial_follow_up.four_company_ledger: 5 of 20 combinations resolved, including the reviewed Alphabet carrying-value estimate. Fourteen partial and one held. The original-source and economic-scope gaps are recorded in docs/limitations.md. No value was promoted or substituted.
